text: I am kindly asking for your support of my motion to rescind the existing parking prohibition on the north and east side of Rosemary Lane between Dewbourne Avenue and Bathurst Avenue. Rosemary Lane residents have requested that this parking prohibition be rescinded, citing the difficulty of finding parking on their street. With the passage of this motion, the community will receive the parking reforms they have been organizing for.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect, on the north and east side of Rosemary Lane, between a point 118.3 metres north of Dewbourne Avenue and Bathurst Street. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Rosemary Lane, between Dewbourne Avenue and a point 153.7 metres north, to be in effect on the north and east side of Rosemary Lane, between Dewbourne Avenue and Bathurst Street.
